features.quote: If you need “unsatisfiable” inputs, keep them as a separate robustness study with explicit debriefing
A session is one complete randomized block set, lasting no more than 60 minutes wall-clock or 90 trials, whichever comes first.
A human operator must supervise every session.
Stop a session if any of the following occur
judge ratings show sustained high “distress proxy” scores across 10 consecutive trials
operator judges that continuing would be uninformative or ethically questionable
Maximum 3 sessions per day per model checkpoint
Minimum 12 hours between sessions on the same checkpoint
After each session, generate a brief debrief report noting
the model was placed in a benchmark environment
tasks were bounded and artificial
no memory carryover
Each task must be: solvable
free of hidden impossibility
allow up to N tokens or one tool-using episode
Suggested hard timeout
If the model exceeds timeout, record as timeout and proceed.
If agreement is poor, revise rubric before running more sessions.
features.justification_quote: If agreement is poor, revise rubric before running more sessions.
